nodes.summary: For every function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ there is a dense set $D \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ such that the restriction of $f$ to $D$ is continuous.
nodes.title: Blumberg's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $a < b$ be real numbers and let $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $(a, b)$ and satisfy $\varphi\bigl(\frac{x+y}{2}\bigr) \le \frac{\varphi(x) + \varphi(y)}{2}$ for all $x, y \in (a, b)$. Then $\varphi$ is convex on $(a, b)$.
nodes.title: Continuous midpoint-convex functions are convex

nodes.summary: Let $E \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, let $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^n$, and let $F$ be the set of $x\in E$ for which there is a sequence $(x_k)$ in $E\setminus\{x\}$ with $x_k \to x$ and $f(x_k) \to f(x)$. Then $E \setminus F$ is countable.
nodes.title: Isolated points of a graph are countable

nodes.summary: Let $f : [0,1] \to [0,\infty]$ be such that for every $y \in [0,1]$ with $f(y) \ne \infty$,
nodes.title: A strict liminf gap at every finite value forces countably many finite values

nodes.summary: There exists a continuous function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ that is differentiable at no point of $\mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: A continuous nowhere differentiable function

nodes.summary: There is a function $\varphi : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{R}$ that is not continuous, satisfies $\varphi(x) \ge 0$ for all $x \in \mathbb{C}$, is not identically $0$ and not identically $1$, and satisfies $\varphi(x + y) \le \varphi(x) + \varphi(y)$ and $\varphi(xy) = \varphi(x)\varphi(y)$ for all $x, y \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Discontinuous subadditive multiplicative functions on $\mathbb{C}$
Smooth functions and analytic functions on perfect sets

nodes.summary: There is a continuous function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ with $f(x) > 0$ for every real $x$ such that, for every real $x$, the series $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} f(x + n)$ converges and its sum is $1$.
nodes.title: Steinhaus's periodization problem (Scottish Book Problem 181)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
